name: ntpd
description: ntpd(8) detaches, reads /etc/ntp.conf and stays up: ps lists a process named ntpd (the marker is built only then, since its log lines also carry the name), and its log shows it resolving each configured server.  /etc/rc starts it only when /etc/netstart brought the network up, and the harness has no network card, so the command starts it; the servers are unknown here.  ntpdc(8) cannot reach it over lo0: the loopback transport carries TCP only.
command: /sbin/ntpd; sleep 5; ps ax | grep 'ntp[d]$' > /tmp/p; test -s /tmp/p && echo NTPD''UP
